s1.text: Toy importers: CPC needs two factory details.

s2.text: First, when it was made. Month and year at least.

s3.text: Second, where. The maker's name and full contact details.

s4.text: Say your CPC just says made in China. That's usually a gap.

s5.text: Free gap list? Comment M and Z, and we'll DM you the link.
